text:
Vera: quick thought: let's add a 'delta-guard' layer to staged config applies. it computes expected cost/latency delta from a snapshot and blocks promotion if delta > threshold. helps ops avoid surprise bills.

Anya: UI: show the predicted delta in the preview screen with a small "what changed" diff. color code (green/yellow/red) and require a typed confirmation for red. :warning:

Raj: telemetry/contract: plan_id + stage_id must be stamped on every metric. emit `delta_estimate` and `observed_delta` time series so we can compare predicted vs actual. low-cardinality buckets only.

Omar: implementation: preflight computes estimate using historical routing fractions + cost-per-token model; store estimate on plan snapshot. router and billing adapters read the snapshot.hash to ensure consistency. if actual delta exceeds estimate * 1.2 for X minutes, trigger alert and optional auto-rollback.

Sumi: ops rules: default block if estimated delta > $50/hr or p95_latency increase > 10ms. allow overrides with `override_reason` and two-step confirm. also require min_samples to trust latency signals.

Vera: minimal example in console preview: ```json
{ "plan_id":"p-2026-09","stages":[{"pct":10,"duration_mins":20}], "estimated_cost_delta_cents_per_hour":4200, "estimate_basis":"historical-route-traffic-v2" }
```

Anya: timeline UX: show estimate vs observed as a small sparkline per-stage, with an explanation tooltip. add keyboard shortcut to abort current stage.

Raj: I'll add the metric names and a Grafana panel template. also bump trace sampling for any stage where observed_delta > 50% of estimate.

Omar: make apply idempotent and CAS on snapshot.hash. if billing adapter fails mid-stage, mark stage degraded and surface a single-click rollback to previous snapshot.

deploy-bot: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4890 - draft delta-guard + console hints. CI: ✅ unit, ⚠️ integration flaky on cost-sim.

Vera: thanks all. i'll draft RFC with exact thresholds and a small simulation harness. volunteers for RFC: Raj (telemetry), Anya (ux), Omar (adapters), Sumi (ops). ping here when ready. :thumbsup:
